explain: The pages for {district} use {n, plural, one {# kind of data} other {# kinds of data}}. {auto} {auto, plural, one {arrives} other {arrive}} automatically from our collectors; the rest are entered by hand from government portals, official reports and other reputed sources such as newspapers and research institutes. Each one's newest date is below, and old data is marked as old.
explainCurrent: Right now {current} of {auto} automatic {auto, plural, one {dataset is} other {datasets are}} current.
tileCurrentSub: Automatic data within its expected time
tileOldSub: Marked as old on their pages

kindHint.auto: Our collectors fetch them from the source on a schedule.
kindHint.news: Picked up from news reports, then checked before they are shown.
kindHint.hand: Typed in from the source's pages and reports, and checked from time to time.
kindHint.published: Published once, like the Census; updated when a new edition comes out.

group.hand: Entered by hand or found in the news

groupHint.auto: These should always be fresh. When one is late, it says how many days old it is.
groupHint.hand: These change slowly. The date is when we last entered or checked them.
groupHint.published: These change only when the publisher brings out a new edition.

how.news: Found in news reports and checked
how.hand: Entered by hand from the source

date.none: Date not published by the source

status.old: {n, plural, one {# day old} other {# days old}}

missingHint: We have no data of these kinds for this district yet. Their pages say so instead of showing empty numbers.
emptyBody: We have not collected any data for {district} yet.
pledge1: Every figure comes from a government portal, an official report or another reputed source, and names it.
pledge2: We never make up numbers. When a source fails or we find nothing, the page says so.
pledge3: Every number shows its date. When data is old, we say how old, and that we could not find newer data.
pledge4: Every change to the data is listed, with its date, on the “What changed and when” page.
expectEvent: Until the source publishes something new
aiSource: Written by our AI helper from the figures on each page
sheetOld: This data is {n, plural, one {# day} other {# days}} old. We could not find newer data. Its page shows the date next to every number.

sheetKind.auto: Our collector fetches this from the source on a schedule. If the source stops answering, the page keeps the last data it had and says how old it is.
sheetKind.news: This is picked up from news reports and checked before it is shown.
sheetKind.hand: This was typed in from the source's pages and reports. The date shows when we last entered or checked it.
sheetKind.published: This comes from a fixed publication and changes only when a new edition comes out.
